title: User login with email and password
story: As a registered user, I want to log in using my email and password so that I can access my account.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
  Given a registered user with valid credentials
  When the user enters the correct email and password
  And clicks the login button
  Then the user is redirected to the dashboard

Scenario: Login fails with incorrect password
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters a valid email and an incorrect password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Login fails with incorrect email
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters an invalid email and a valid password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Login fails with invalid email and password
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters an invalid email and an invalid password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Login with blank email
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user leaves the email field blank and enters a valid password
  Then a validation message for the email field is displayed

Scenario: Login with blank password
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user enters a valid email and leaves the password blank
  Then a validation message for the password field is displayed

Scenario: Login with blank email and password
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user leaves both fields blank
  Then validation messages are displayed for both fields

Scenario: Account locks after five failed attempts
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters invalid credentials five consecutive times
  Then the account is locked
  And the user is informed that the account is locked

Scenario: Login attempt after account is locked
  Given the user's account is locked
  When the user enters valid credentials
  Then login is denied
  And an account locked message is displayed

Scenario: Password field masks entered characters
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user types a password
  Then the password characters are masked

Scenario: SQL injection attempt in email field
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user enters "' OR '1'='1" as the email
  And enters any password
  Then login is denied
  And the application safely rejects the malicious input

Scenario: Cross-site scripting attempt in email field
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user enters "<script>alert('XSS')</script>" in the email field
  Then the application sanitizes the input
  And login is denied

Scenario: Login with uppercase email address
  Given a user registered with email "user@example.com"
  When the user enters "USER@EXAMPLE.COM" and correct password
  Then login is successful and email is treated case-insensitively

Scenario: Login with trailing space in email
  Given a user registered with email "user@example.com"
  When the user enters "user@example.com " and correct password
  Then the trailing space is trimmed and login succeeds

Scenario: Login with leading space in password
  Given a user with password "SecurePass123"
  When the user enters " SecurePass123"
  Then login fails due to password mismatch

Scenario: Remember Me option keeps user logged in
  Given the user is on login page
  When the user checks "Remember Me" and logs in
  Then session remains active after browser is closed and reopened

Scenario: Unchecked Remember Me terminates session on browser close
  Given the user is on login page
  When the user unchecks "Remember Me" and logs in
  Then session terminates when the browser tab is closed

Scenario: Password reveal toggle icon functionality
  Given the password field contains masked text
  When the user clicks the toggle eye icon
  Then the password becomes visible in plain text

Scenario: Login rate limiting after multiple rapid requests
  Given the login API is called 20 times in 10 seconds from same IP
  When another attempt is made
  Then HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests is returned

Scenario: Concurrent session handling
  Given a user is logged in on Browser A
  When the user logs in from Browser B
  Then the session on Browser A is terminated or handled per security policy
test_cases:
Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
  Given a registered user with valid credentials
  When the user enters the correct email and password
  And clicks the login button
  Then the user is redirected to the dashboard

Scenario: Login fails with incorrect password
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters a valid email and an incorrect password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Account locks after repeated failed attempts
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters incorrect credentials 5 times in a row
  Then the account is locked
  And the user sees a message indicating the account is locked

title: Password reset via email
story: As a user who forgot my password, I want to reset it via an emailed link so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Successful password reset request
  Given a user with a registered email
  When the user requests a password reset
  Then a reset link is sent to their email

Scenario: Expired reset link is rejected
  Given a user has an expired password reset link
  When the user clicks the link
  Then an error message indicating the link has expired is shown

Scenario: New password fails complexity rules
  Given a user is on the reset password page
  When the user submits a password shorter than 8 characters
  Then an error is shown indicating password requirements were not met

Scenario: Reset request for non-existent email
  Given an unregistered email address
  When the user submits the email on password reset page
  Then a generic confirmation message is displayed to prevent email enumeration

Scenario: Reset password link single-use enforcement
  Given a user successfully resets password using a token
  When the user clicks the same link again
  Then an error message "Token already used" is displayed

Scenario: Password reset link invalidated on new request
  Given a reset token was previously emailed to user
  When the user requests a second reset token
  Then the first token is invalidated and only the second works

Scenario: Password complexity validation - missing uppercase
  Given user is on reset page
  When user enters "lowercase123!"
  Then an error message requiring at least one uppercase letter is displayed

Scenario: Password complexity validation - missing number
  Given user is on reset page
  When user enters "NoNumbersHere!"
  Then an error message requiring at least one numeric digit is displayed

Scenario: Password complexity validation - missing special character
  Given user is on reset page
  When user enters "NoSpecialChar123"
  Then an error message requiring at least one special character is displayed

Scenario: Password reset matching confirmation password
  Given user enters a valid new password
  When confirmation password does not match new password
  Then an error message "Passwords do not match" is shown

Scenario: Password reset using previous password
  Given user enters a valid new password that matches current password
  When submitted
  Then system rejects with message "New password cannot be same as old password"

Scenario: Password reset token tamper test
  Given a valid reset URL
  When user modifies the URL token parameter
  Then system displays "Invalid or corrupted reset token"

Scenario: Successful password reset clears locked state
  Given an account locked due to failed login attempts
  When user successfully resets password via email link
  Then account is unlocked and user can log in with new password

Scenario: Password reset confirmation email sent
  Given user successfully completes password reset
  When the change is saved
  Then a confirmation email notifying password change is sent

Scenario: Password reset rate limit
  Given user requested 5 reset emails within 5 minutes
  When requesting a 6th email
  Then system blocks request with rate limit warning

Scenario: Password reset link click after user password already changed elsewhere
  Given user requested a reset link
  And changed password via account settings before clicking link
  When clicking the reset link
  Then token is invalid

Scenario: XSS attack attempt in new password field
  Given user inputs script payload in password field
  When submitted
  Then input is sanitized/hashed safely without executing script

Scenario: Blank new password submission
  Given user leaves password field empty
  When submit is clicked
  Then validation message "Password is required" appears

Scenario: Password reset page access without token
  Given user attempts to access `/reset-password` without token parameter
  When page loads
  Then user is redirected to login page

Scenario: Password reset email timeout check
  Given user requests password reset
  When email delivery system processes request
  Then reset email is delivered within 30 seconds
test_cases:
Scenario: Successful password reset request
  Given a user with a registered email
  When the user requests a password reset
  Then a reset link is sent to their email

Scenario: Expired reset link is rejected
  Given a user has an expired password reset link
  When the user clicks the link
  Then an error message indicating the link has expired is shown

Scenario: New password fails complexity rules
  Given a user is on the reset password page
  When the user submits a password shorter than 8 characters
  Then an error is shown indicating password requirements were not met

title: Add item to shopping cart
story: As a shopper, I want to add products to my cart so that I can purchase multiple items at once.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Add in-stock item to cart
  Given a product is in stock
  When the user clicks "Add to Cart"
  Then the item appears in the cart with quantity 1

Scenario: Attempt to add out-of-stock item
  Given a product is out of stock
  When the user views the product page
  Then the "Add to Cart" button is disabled

Scenario: Cart persists after logout and login
  Given a logged-in user has items in their cart
  When the user logs out and logs back in
  Then the cart still contains the previously added items

Scenario: Increment item quantity in cart
  Given an item is already in the cart with quantity 1
  When user clicks "Add to Cart" again on product page
  Then cart quantity for that item updates to 2

Scenario: Exceed maximum inventory limit when adding to cart
  Given an item has 3 units remaining in stock
  And user already has 3 units in cart
  When user attempts to add 1 more unit
  Then system displays "Maximum available quantity already in cart"

Scenario: Add guest cart to logged-in account (Cart Merge)
  Given an anonymous guest user adds Item A to cart
  When guest logs into an existing account with Item B in cart
  Then cart merges to contain both Item A and Item B

Scenario: Add item with variants (size and color)
  Given a product with Size M and Red selected
  When user clicks "Add to Cart"
  Then cart displays the specific Red - Size M variant

Scenario: Add item without selecting required variant
  Given a product requiring size selection
  When user clicks "Add to Cart" without selecting size
  Then validation message "Please select a size" is shown

Scenario: Real-time cart count badge update
  Given cart header icon displays badge count 2
  When user adds 1 item to cart
  Then cart badge count updates immediately to 3

Scenario: Add item while product price updates concurrently
  Given product is displayed at $20
  When admin updates price to $25 and user adds to cart
  Then cart captures updated price $25 with notification

Scenario: Add item with quantity input field
  Given user inputs quantity 5 on product page
  When user clicks "Add to Cart"
  Then item added to cart with quantity 5

Scenario: Add item with negative quantity input
  Given user inputs quantity -1 on product page
  When user clicks "Add to Cart"
  Then system resets quantity to 1 or displays error

Scenario: Add item with non-numeric quantity input
  Given user types "abc" in quantity input field
  When field loses focus
  Then value defaults back to 1

Scenario: Add digital download product to cart
  Given a digital downloadable item
  When user adds item to cart
  Then item is added with max quantity fixed to 1

Scenario: Add bundled product to cart
  Given a bundle product containing 3 items
  When user adds bundle to cart
  Then bundle appears as single line item with included sub-items

Scenario: Add item when inventory becomes depleted concurrently
  Given item has 1 unit left
  When User A and User B click "Add to Cart" simultaneously
  Then first request succeeds and second receives out of stock notification

Scenario: Mini-cart drawer confirmation display
  Given user is on category listing page
  When user clicks "Quick Add"
  Then mini-cart drawer slides open displaying added item details

Scenario: Add item exceeding max cart limit quantity (e.g. 99)
  Given cart quantity for an item is 95
  When user attempts to add 10 more
  Then system caps quantity at 99 and displays warning

Scenario: Add restricted item based on country location
  Given user location is set to Country X
  And product is restricted in Country X
  When user views product
  Then "Add to Cart" button is replaced with restriction notice

Scenario: Session expiration for guest cart
  Given guest user added items 30 days ago
  When user returns after cookie expiration
  Then guest cart is empty or reset
test_cases:
Scenario: Add in-stock item to cart
  Given a product is in stock
  When the user clicks "Add to Cart"
  Then the item appears in the cart with quantity 1

Scenario: Attempt to add out-of-stock item
  Given a product is out of stock
  When the user views the product page
  Then the "Add to Cart" button is disabled

Scenario: Cart persists after logout and login
  Given a logged-in user has items in their cart
  When the user logs out and logs back in
  Then the cart still contains the previously added items

title: Apply discount coupon at checkout
story: As a shopper, I want to apply a discount coupon at checkout so that I can get a reduced price on my order.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Apply valid coupon
  Given a shopper has items in their cart
  When they enter a valid, active coupon code
  Then the order total is reduced by the coupon amount

Scenario: Reject expired coupon
  Given a shopper enters an expired coupon code
  When they apply the coupon
  Then an error message "Coupon expired" is displayed and total remains unchanged

Scenario: Prevent stacking multiple coupons
  Given a shopper has already applied one valid coupon
  When they try to apply a second coupon
  Then the system rejects the second coupon with a message explaining only one coupon is allowed

Scenario: Apply percentage-based coupon code
  Given cart total is $100
  When shopper applies code "SAVE20" (20% off)
  Then discount of $20 is applied and new subtotal is $80

Scenario: Apply fixed amount coupon code
  Given cart total is $50
  When shopper applies code "10OFF"
  Then discount of $10 is applied and new subtotal is $40

Scenario: Coupon code case insensitivity
  Given valid coupon code "SUMMER10"
  When shopper enters "summer10"
  Then coupon is successfully accepted and applied

Scenario: Apply coupon below minimum purchase threshold
  Given coupon requires $100 minimum spend
  And cart total is $75
  When shopper applies coupon
  Then error "Minimum order amount of $100 required for this coupon" is shown

Scenario: Apply coupon restricted to specific category
  Given coupon is valid only for Electronics
  And cart contains only Apparel items
  When shopper applies coupon
  Then error "Coupon not applicable to items in your cart" is shown

Scenario: Coupon single-use per customer limit
  Given shopper previously redeemed one-time code "WELCOME10"
  When shopper attempts to enter "WELCOME10" on a second order
  Then error "Coupon has already been redeemed" is shown

Scenario: Coupon usage limit exceeded globally
  Given coupon has reached maximum global redemption limit
  When shopper tries to apply code
  Then error "Coupon promotion limit reached" is displayed

Scenario: Remove applied coupon code
  Given shopper has applied valid coupon "DISCOUNT15"
  When shopper clicks "Remove Coupon" button
  Then coupon is detached and cart total recalculates to original price

Scenario: Apply coupon with whitespace in input
  Given valid coupon "FALL2026"
  When shopper enters " FALL2026 "
  Then code is trimmed and successfully applied

Scenario: Apply invalid random coupon string
  Given non-existent coupon "XYZ12345"
  When shopper attempts application
  Then error "Invalid promo code" is displayed

Scenario: Apply coupon when cart modified below minimum requirement
  Given coupon requiring $50 minimum was applied to $60 cart
  When shopper removes an item reducing subtotal to $30
  Then coupon is automatically removed with notification message

Scenario: Discount total exceeds order subtotal
  Given fixed $50 coupon applied to $30 order
  When applied
  Then subtotal becomes $0 and remaining balance is not negative

Scenario: Free shipping coupon code application
  Given shipping fee is $9.99
  When shopper applies free shipping coupon "FREESHIP"
  Then shipping cost updates to $0.00

Scenario: Coupon application order with tax calculation
  Given subtotal $100, coupon $20 off, tax rate 10%
  When coupon is applied
  Then tax is calculated on discounted subtotal ($80 * 10% = $8)

Scenario: Apply coupon code with special characters
  Given coupon code is "BLACK-FRIDAY!"
  When entered correctly by shopper
  Then coupon is accepted and applied

Scenario: Coupon expiration during checkout session
  Given coupon expires at 12:00 PM
  And shopper enters code at 12:01 PM
  Then coupon is rejected as expired

Scenario: Empty coupon code field submission
  Given coupon input field is empty
  When shopper clicks "Apply"
  Then error message "Please enter a coupon code" is shown
test_cases:
Scenario: Apply valid coupon
  Given a shopper has items in their cart
  When they enter a valid, active coupon code
  Then the order total is reduced by the coupon amount

Scenario: Reject expired coupon
  Given a shopper enters an expired coupon code
  When they apply the coupon
  Then an error message "Coupon expired" is displayed and total remains unchanged

Scenario: Prevent stacking multiple coupons
  Given a shopper has already applied one valid coupon
  When they try to apply a second coupon
  Then the system rejects the second coupon with a message explaining only one coupon is allowed

title: Upload profile picture
story: As a user, I want to upload a profile picture so that my account feels personalized.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Successful profile picture upload
  Given a user selects a valid JPG image under 5MB
  When they upload the image
  Then the image is saved and displayed as their profile picture

Scenario: Reject unsupported file format
  Given a user selects a .gif file
  When they attempt to upload it
  Then an error message indicating unsupported format is shown

Scenario: Reject file exceeding size limit
  Given a user selects an image larger than 5MB
  When they attempt to upload it
  Then an error message indicating the file is too large is shown

Scenario: Successful PNG image upload
  Given a user selects a 2MB PNG file
  When uploaded
  Then image is processed and displayed correctly

Scenario: Upload non-image file with image extension renamed
  Given a user renames executable file `script.exe` to `photo.jpg`
  When user attempts to upload
  Then file type verification fails and error "Invalid image content" is displayed

Scenario: Image cropping adjustment tool interaction
  Given a non-square 1920x1080 JPEG photo uploaded
  When preview opens
  Then user can drag crop area to select square thumbnail

Scenario: Cancel image upload preview
  Given image preview modal is displayed
  When user clicks "Cancel"
  Then upload is aborted and original profile image is preserved

Scenario: Profile picture replacement
  Given user already has an existing profile picture
  When user uploads new valid picture
  Then previous picture is deleted and replaced with new image

Scenario: Remove profile picture option
  Given user has a custom profile picture
  When user clicks "Remove Picture"
  Then picture is deleted and default avatar is displayed

Scenario: Upload picture with exact 5MB boundary size
  Given file size is exactly 5.00 MB
  When user uploads
  Then upload succeeds without error

Scenario: Upload picture slightly over 5MB limit (e.g. 5.01MB)
  Given file size is 5.01 MB
  When user uploads
  Then error "File size exceeds maximum 5MB limit" is displayed

Scenario: Upload corrupted image file
  Given image file header is damaged
  When user selects file for upload
  Then system displays error "Corrupted file format"

Scenario: Upload image with SVG format containing script (XSS prevention)
  Given file is SVG with embedded `<script>` tag
  When user attempts upload
  Then system rejects file format or strips executable content

Scenario: Responsive thumbnail display verification
  Given user uploads profile picture
  When viewing on mobile screen and desktop screen
  Then avatar renders properly formatted thumbnail in both views

Scenario: Drag and drop picture upload
  Given user opens profile settings
  When user drags image file into drag-and-drop dropzone
  Then upload preview activates automatically

Scenario: Server error during picture processing
  Given server storage goes offline during save
  When user uploads photo
  Then graceful error message "Upload failed. Please try again later" is displayed

Scenario: Profile picture update reflected in header navigation
  Given user updates profile picture
  When picture save succeeds
  Then top-right navigation bar user avatar updates immediately without full page refresh

Scenario: Upload WEBP format image
  Given system supports WEBP
  When user uploads 1MB WEBP file
  Then upload completes successfully

Scenario: Upload picture with EXIF metadata (Privacy check)
  Given JPEG contains GPS location metadata
  When processed by server
  Then EXIF location data is stripped from output file

Scenario: Rapid consecutive upload attempts
  Given user clicks upload button repeatedly while uploading
  When processing
  Then upload button is disabled during processing to prevent duplicates
test_cases:
Scenario: Successful profile picture upload
  Given a user selects a valid JPG image under 5MB
  When they upload the image
  Then the image is saved and displayed as their profile picture

Scenario: Reject unsupported file format
  Given a user selects a .gif file
  When they attempt to upload it
  Then an error message indicating unsupported format is shown

Scenario: Reject file exceeding size limit
  Given a user selects an image larger than 5MB
  When they attempt to upload it
  Then an error message indicating the file is too large is shown

title: Search products by keyword
story: As a shopper, I want to search for products by keyword so that I can quickly find what I'm looking for.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Search returns relevant results
  Given products exist matching a keyword
  When the user searches for that keyword
  Then matching products are displayed ranked by relevance

Scenario: Search with no results
  Given no products match the search keyword
  When the user searches
  Then a message "No products found" is displayed with suggestions

Scenario: Filter search results by price range
  Given a user has searched for a keyword
  When they apply a price filter
  Then only results within that price range are shown

Scenario: Typo tolerance in search keyword
  Given user searches for "lakptop"
  When search executes
  Then system displays results for "laptop" with note "Showing results for laptop"

Scenario: Empty search term submission
  Given user places cursor in search bar and presses Enter with blank query
  When search runs
  Then page remains on current view or prompts user to type query

Scenario: Search auto-complete suggestions dropdown
  Given user types "run"
  When key is pressed
  Then auto-complete dropdown suggests "running shoes", "running shorts", "runner"

Scenario: Filter search results by category
  Given search results for "shoes"
  When user filters by category "Athletic"
  Then list updates to show only athletic shoes

Scenario: Sort search results by Price Low to High
  Given search results list
  When user selects sort option "Price: Low to High"
  Then products reorder starting from lowest price

Scenario: Sort search results by Customer Rating
  Given search results list
  When user selects sort option "Highest Rated"
  Then products reorder by average review score descending

Scenario: Search with special characters
  Given user inputs string "T-shirt & Jeans @2026!"
  When search is executed
  Then search handles characters cleanly without crashing

Scenario: Search by product SKU or model number
  Given product with SKU "SKU-98765"
  When user searches "SKU-98765"
  Then product page or direct result is returned

Scenario: Search pagination navigation
  Given search yields 50 results with 20 items per page
  When user clicks Page 2
  Then items 21 through 40 are displayed

Scenario: Clear search input button
  Given search bar contains text "wireless headphones"
  When user clicks the 'X' clear button inside search input
  Then input field clears and focus remains in input

Scenario: Multiple applied filter combination
  Given search results for "jacket"
  When user selects Brand="North" and Color="Black"
  Then only black jackets from North brand are displayed

Scenario: Clear all active filters
  Given user has 3 active search filters
  When user clicks "Clear All Filters"
  Then all filters are reset and original full search list renders

Scenario: SQL injection attempt in search box
  Given user enters `' UNION SELECT * FROM users--` in search
  When search executes
  Then application safely executes query returning 0 results
Scenario: XSS injection attempt in search box Given user enters `` in search When search executes Then system displays sanitized string safely as text

Scenario: Search term highlighting in results
  Given user searches for "leather boots"
  When results render
  Then matching keyword terms "leather" and "boots" are highlighted in product titles

Scenario: Search response time under peak load
  Given catalog contains 100,000 products
  When user executes search
  Then results load within 1.5 seconds

Scenario: Recent searches history display
  Given logged-in user previously searched "smartwatch"
  When user clicks search bar
  Then recent search history displays "smartwatch"
test_cases:
Scenario: Search returns relevant results
  Given products exist matching a keyword
  When the user searches for that keyword
  Then matching products are displayed ranked by relevance

Scenario: Search with no results
  Given no products match the search keyword
  When the user searches
  Then a message "No products found" is displayed with suggestions

Scenario: Filter search results by price range
  Given a user has searched for a keyword
  When they apply a price filter
  Then only results within that price range are shown

title: Apply promotional codes at checkout
story: As a customer, I want to apply promotional codes at checkout, so that I can get discounts on my purchase.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Promo code input field visible on checkout page
  Given customer is on the checkout page
  When viewing order summary section
  Then a dedicated promo code input box and apply button are clearly displayed

Scenario: System validates code format and expiration
  Given customer inputs promo code
  When apply button is clicked
  Then system validates code against date bounds and structural pattern

Scenario: Discount amount displays in order summary
  Given a valid promo code is applied
  When checkout summary renders
  Then promo discount line item displays amount subtracted from subtotal

Scenario: Invalid code shows error message
  Given customer enters non-existent promo code "INVALID2026"
  When applied
  Then explicit error message "Promo code is invalid" appears

Scenario: User can remove applied code
  Given promo code is currently active on order
  When customer clicks remove button
  Then code is detached and order total updates back to original price

Scenario: Discount is applied before tax calculation
  Given subtotal of $100 and 10% tax rate
  When $20 discount code is applied
  Then tax is calculated as 10% of $80 ($8.00) resulting in total $88.00

Scenario: Promo code expired error message
  Given promo code expired yesterday
  When customer submits code
  Then system displays error "This promo code expired on [Date]"

Scenario: Promo code case insensitivity verification
  Given code "SAVE10NOW"
  When entered as "save10now"
  Then system treats input as case-insensitive and applies discount

Scenario: Attempt to apply multiple promo codes
  Given customer already applied promo code "PROMO1"
  When attempting to enter promo code "PROMO2"
  Then system prompts that only one promotional code can be active

Scenario: Minimum subtotal restriction not met
  Given promo code requiring $50 minimum subtotal
  And current cart subtotal is $30
  When customer applies code
  Then error "Add $20.00 more to qualify for this promo code" appears

Scenario: Promo code limited to specific user segment
  Given VIP-only promo code
  When standard non-VIP customer applies code
  Then error "This promo code is not applicable to your account" appears

Scenario: Promo code trimmed for leading or trailing whitespace
  Given code "WINTER50"
  When customer enters " WINTER50 "
  Then code is successfully validated and applied

Scenario: Promo code single-use limit enforcement
  Given customer already used code "ONETIME"
  When customer attempts to use "ONETIME" on new order
  Then error "You have already used this promo code" appears

Scenario: Removal of items invalidating promo condition
  Given promo code requiring 3 items in cart
  When customer removes 1 item reducing total count to 2
  Then promo code is automatically removed and message is shown

Scenario: Promo code applying free shipping
  Given standard shipping rate is $5.00
  When customer applies promo code "FREESHIP2026"
  Then shipping charge updates to $0.00 in order breakdown

Scenario: Promo code maximum discount cap enforcement
  Given 50% discount code with maximum cap of $100
  When applied to $300 purchase
  Then discount is capped at $100 instead of $150

Scenario: Copy-pasted promo code with hidden formatting characters
  Given customer copy-pastes code with non-printable unicode
  When code is submitted
  Then input field sanitizes string and successfully processes code

Scenario: Promo code applied to excluded sale items
  Given cart contains items tagged as "Clearance - Non-eligible"
  When customer applies general promo code
  Then discount applies only to eligible non-clearance items

Scenario: Currency matching for localized promo code
  Given promo code valid only for USD currency
  When customer checks out in EUR currency
  Then error message regarding currency incompatibility is displayed

Scenario: Promo code real-time re-calculation on cart updates
  Given 10% off promo code applied to $100 cart
  When customer adds $50 item to cart during checkout
  Then discount updates automatically from $10 to $15
test_cases:
Scenario: Promo code input field visible on checkout page
  Given customer is on the checkout page
  When viewing order summary section
  Then a dedicated promo code input box and apply button are clearly displayed

Scenario: System validates code format and expiration
  Given customer inputs promo code
  When apply button is clicked
  Then system validates code against date bounds and structural pattern

Scenario: Discount amount displays in order summary
  Given a valid promo code is applied
  When checkout summary renders
  Then promo discount line item displays amount subtracted from subtotal

title: Save products to a wishlist
story: As a shopper, I want to save products to a wishlist, so that I can purchase them later.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Heart icon available on product cards
  Given customer is browsing catalog or product pages
  When product card renders
  Then an interactive heart icon is clearly displayed on the card

Scenario: Wishlist accessible from user menu
  Given customer is logged into their account
  When user clicks account drop-down menu
  Then "My Wishlist" link is accessible

Scenario: Wishlist displays saved products with current prices

title: Seamless checkout experience
story: As a customer, I want a seamless checkout experience, so that I can complete my purchase quickly.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Checkout button visible on cart page
  Given user has items in cart
  When viewing cart page
  Then prominent "Proceed to Checkout" button is visible

Scenario: Shipping address form accepts full address
  Given user is on checkout shipping step
  When user fills street address, city, state, zip, and country
  Then form validates and saves shipping address

Scenario: Payment method selection (Credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay)
  Given user is on payment step
  When viewing options
  Then Credit Card, PayPal, and Apple Pay radio choices are available

Scenario: Order summary shows before final confirmation
  Given user filled shipping and payment details
  When reaching final review step
  Then full order summary with itemized prices, taxes, and shipping fee displays

Scenario: Confirmation email sent upon successful payment
  Given payment processing succeeds
  When order is placed
  Then automated order confirmation email is dispatched to customer

Scenario: Order number displayed after completion
  Given order placement is completed
  When thank-you success page loads
  Then unique order confirmation number is displayed

Scenario: Express Guest Checkout option
  Given user is not logged in
  When clicking checkout button
  Then user is offered option to "Checkout as Guest" without password creation

Scenario: Validation error on incomplete shipping address
  Given user leaves Zip/Postal code blank
  When clicking Next
  Then field highlights red with validation message "Zip code is required"

Scenario: Select saved shipping address for logged-in user
  Given logged-in user has saved addresses
  When opening shipping step
  Then address selector allows choosing existing address with one click

Scenario: Credit card validation - invalid card number
  Given user selects Credit Card payment
  When entering non-Luhn compliant card number
  Then error message "Invalid credit card number" appears

Scenario: Credit card validation - expired date
  Given card expiry date entered is in the past
  When payment submitted
  Then error message "Card has expired" is displayed

Scenario: Credit card validation - invalid CVV length
  Given user enters 2 digit CVV for Visa
  When submitted
  Then error message "CVV must be 3 digits" appears

Scenario: Redirect to PayPal sandbox/gateway
  Given user selects PayPal payment method
  When clicking "Place Order"
  Then user is redirected securely to PayPal authorization portal

Scenario: Cancel PayPal payment redirect
  Given user is on PayPal payment portal
  When user clicks cancel and return
  Then user is returned to checkout review page with message "Payment canceled"

Scenario: Apple Pay biometric authorization trigger
  Given supported Apple Pay device
  When user selects Apple Pay
  Then native FaceID/TouchID prompt appears for payment authorization

Scenario: Billing address same as shipping address checkbox
  Given shipping address is entered
  When "Billing address same as shipping" is checked
  Then billing address fields auto-populate and lock

Scenario: Uncheck billing address same as shipping
  Given box is unchecked
  When viewing billing section
  Then separate input form for billing address renders

Scenario: Handle failed payment transaction gracefully
  Given payment gateway returns decline response
  When processing payment
  Then user remains on checkout page with error "Payment declined. Please try another card"

Scenario: Inventory reservation during checkout lockout timeout
  Given item inventory reserved during checkout
  When user abandons session for 15 minutes
  Then reserved stock releases back to main inventory

Scenario: Order confirmation page reload prevention
  Given user is on post-checkout success confirmation page
  When user refreshes page
  Then order is not re-submitted and same receipt details display safely

title: User registration and account creation
story: As a new site visitor, I want to create an account so that I can save my information and track orders.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Successful registration with valid data
  Given new visitor on registration page
  When entering valid full name, unique email, and strong password
  And accepts Terms of Service
  Then account is created and user is redirected to welcome dashboard

Scenario: Registration fails with already registered email
  Given email "existing@example.com" is already registered
  When new user attempts registration with "existing@example.com"
  Then system displays error "Email address is already in use"

Scenario: Registration fails with weak password
  Given user enters password "12345"
  When submit is clicked
  Then system displays error message detailing missing password complexity requirements

Scenario: Registration fails without accepting terms
  Given user fills valid details
  When leaving "Terms and Conditions" checkbox unchecked
  Then submission fails with error "You must accept terms and conditions"

Scenario: Form submission with empty required fields
  Given registration form displayed
  When submit clicked with all fields blank
  Then validation errors display under Name, Email, and Password fields

Scenario: Invalid email format registration attempt
  Given user enters "invalidemail@"
  When submitting form
  Then error "Please enter a valid email address" is shown

Scenario: Verification email sent upon registration
  Given registration succeeds
  When account record is created
  Then email verification message containing activation link is dispatched

Scenario: Click email verification link activates account
  Given user receives activation link
  When clicking link in browser
  Then account status changes to verified and success message displays

Scenario: Expired verification token handling
  Given email activation link expired after 24 hours
  When user clicks link
  Then error page displays option to "Resend Verification Email"

Scenario: Password and Confirm Password mismatch
  Given user enters "Password123!" in password field
  And "Password456!" in confirm password field
  Then validation error "Passwords do not match" is shown

Scenario: Trim whitespace in registration name and email
  Given user enters " John Doe " in full name field
  When account is created
  Then stored name is trimmed to "John Doe"

Scenario: Registration with maximum character length in fields
  Given user enters 255 character string in name field
  When submitted
  Then system processes or truncates per maximum database limits without crash

Scenario: Registration CAPTCHA validation success
  Given reCAPTCHA widget present on registration form
  When user completes CAPTCHA successfully and submits
  Then registration proceeds

Scenario: Registration CAPTCHA failure
  Given reCAPTCHA failed or incomplete
  When user clicks register
  Then system displays "Please complete the CAPTCHA verification"

Scenario: Social registration via Google OAuth
  Given user clicks "Sign up with Google"
  When authenticating successfully on Google portal
  Then system creates account linked to Google email

Scenario: Social registration via Facebook OAuth
  Given user clicks "Sign up with Facebook"
  When authorized
  Then account created and user logged in

Scenario: Registration rate limit per IP
  Given 10 registration attempts from same IP within 1 minute
  When 11th request sent
  Then system blocks request with rate limiting response

Scenario: Password field masking on registration form
  Given user typing in password input field
  When typing
  Then characters are hidden as dots/asterisks with show password option

Scenario: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) protection on registration
  Given registration request sent without valid CSRF token
  When processed by backend
  Then server rejects request with status 403 Forbidden

Scenario: Auto login after successful registration
  Given automatic login setting enabled
  When user completes registration
  Then session token is generated immediately without requiring separate login
